name: @qntx/wallet-wasm
description: Web/Node host package for @qntx/wallet — spawns the wallet kernel in a Worker
author: QuantX <x@qntx.org>

scripts.build: vp run @qntx/wallet#build && vp pack && bun build --target node --outfile dist/kernel.node.js src/worker/node.ts && bun build --target browser --outfile dist/kernel.worker.js src/worker/browser.ts
scripts.test: vp run @qntx/wallet#build && bun build --target node --outfile dist/kernel.node.js src/worker/node.ts && vp test
scripts.test:browser: bun run build && playwright test --config tests/browser/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: vp run @qntx/wallet#build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.src.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/browser/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/browser/page/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:pkg: bun run build && publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only
scripts.pack:local: bun run build && bun pm pack
